channel.title: JLT Agent Wins (Facebook)
channel.description: Agent Wins — celebrating JLT agent milestones for the JLT Group community

item.title: Agent Win — Catherine Thorpe
item.description:
Celebrating Catherine Thorpe today… 2 years within JLT, and what two years they've been. 🎉
In that time Catherine has sold £1.66 million worth of holidays, capped off by her biggest month yet at around £70k. She's built this business around her family, finding a way of working that fits her own life.
What we love about Catherine's story is what she's built alongside it too: a Facebook community for solo parents that's grown from around 1,000 members to nearly 10,000, and this month her first solo-parent shared holiday travelled, with 4 families already booked for the 2027 repeat.
Within JLT, this is what strong foundations look like. Congratulations, Catherine. We're so proud of you. ❤️

item.title: Agent Win — Kirsty Dowden
item.description:
Agent Spotlight: Kirsty 🎉
Kirsty Dowden made her first booking in March 2026… and by July 2026 she had already reached £105,816 in bookings and hit her annual target.
Within JLT, this is what strong foundations look like. Kirsty joined in January, worked through the comprehensive training, and got her business moving. In June 2026 she was on a FAM trip to Türkiye with Holiday Best. And she is doing all of this while holding down a full-time role as a School Business Manager.
In Kirsty's own words: "If I can do this alongside a busy full-time career, then so can you."
Cheering you on, Kirsty ❤️

item.title: Agent Win — Amy Hoey
item.description:
Celebrating Amy Hoey, who completed a Louis Hotel Group "Holi-cation" FAM trip in Paphos, Cyprus. ✨
Amy spent four nights at the newly opened Imperial Island Resort on premium all-inclusive, with a day pass to the adult-only Cali Resort and Spa at Coral Bay, cocktail nights, and a boat trip to the Blue Lagoon outside Polis.
Within JLT, FAM trips like this are how knowledge gets built. Amy came back with first-hand experience of the rooms, the resort feel, and a direct relationship with UK rep Chris Swaine for enquiries.
Her verdict: Cyprus is now top of her own list for a family holiday. 🌍
Huge congratulations, Amy.

item.title: Agent Win — Francesca
item.description:
Celebrating Francesca, who launched Travel by Francesca in October 2025 and has been building fast ever since. ✨
She's now booked 29 holidays worth £121,000… all while learning suppliers, destinations, systems and social media from a standing start.
Within JLT, this is what consistency looks like. Learning the fundamentals and turning them into real, bookable results.
What we love about Francesca's approach is the range of ground she's covered… supplier training, destination research, systems mastery and social media, all picked up and put straight to work. 🥂
Huge congratulations Francesca. Here's to what's next. 🌍

item.title: Agent Win — Sophie Wilkin
item.description:
Agent Spotlight: Sophie 🎉
Sophie Wilkin was selected by Royal Caribbean to join the pre-sailing of their newest ship, Legend of the Seas, ahead of the ship's maiden voyage in July. What a way to make your mark.
Within JLT, moments like this are exactly what we love to celebrate. Being invited aboard a brand new ship before it officially sets sail is a genuine privilege… and the sort of first-hand experience that stays with you.
In Sophie's own words: "Shocked, scared and feeling very grateful!"
And it was her first ever cruise.
Congratulations, Sophie 👏

item.title: Agent Win — Mark Heath
item.description:
Mark Heath joined JLT just under a year ago… and look what's happened. ✈️
Since his very first booking on 1st July 2025, Mark has completed 63 bookings and crossed £200,000 in gross holiday sales, reaching his year-one target three weeks early.
What makes this stand out is the context. Mark has built this business alongside a full-time job that already runs around 55 hours a week. The late nights, early mornings and weekends are right there in the numbers.
Within JLT, this is what showing up consistently looks like.
His goal was simple: enough commission to fund his own family holidays. This summer he's taking the kids to Walt Disney World in Orlando, paid for by the business he's built. ✨
Huge congratulations Mark.
